title: Guy's Ridiculous Attempt to Escape from Deputy Goes Wrong
description:
► USCCA - Mother's Day Special! Get a FREE Dashcam when you activate your membership. 
https://www.uscca.com/codeblue 

On May 3, 2023, two occupants in a vehicle were arrested after they led a chase through multiple farm fields in Dekorra, WI. Initially, a deputy noticed the vehicle appearing to avoid him. When a traffic stop was attempted, the vehicle fled at a high rate of speed. 

► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
